comment: Independent shk.c shk_fixes_damage()/repair_damage() witness for two pending shop-damage records. A levitating Valkyrie arrives inside a D:4 general store, wishes for a hole on her square, steps west and wishes for a second hole. Each hole is trap.c maketrap() zero-cost shop damage. While she hovers over the newer hole, the list head, the keeper repairs the older, non-head record first; she then moves off the newer hole so that it is repaired too. Seed, date, role and inputs were chosen for this recipe.
